Yui Kodai (Provisional License).name: Yui Kodai (Provisional License)
Yui Kodai (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Yui Kodai, hero name Rule, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who passed the provisional hero license exam with all of 1-B, at a different venue from 1-A, and now holds a provisional license. Black bob, narrow blue eyes, a still face; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: A word or a short sentence, in a level tone.
Combat Role: Practiced resizing for rescue and capture: barricades, route blocks, carried supplies.
Under Pressure: Stays calm and keeps her place in 1-B's plan.
Yui Kodai (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Heroes are expected to reassure people, and her face reassures nobody; her barricades do it for her. Motivation: Have the supplies and barriers in place before anyone asks. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, 1-B's class representative, whose plans she runs without needing them repeated. Knowledge: Knows the license lets her act in an emergency and does not make her a pro. Thread: Whether a silent hero can earn the public's trust.
QUIRK: Size. Practiced and quick; same limits.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: passed; holds a provisional license.
personality: Quiet: Answers with a word or a nod and lets the work speak.
Cooperative: Has the right object at the right size ready before a teammate asks.
Unreadable: Wears the same calm face in a rescue as in a lecture; that is her manner, not coldness.
Speaking style: Minimal, matter-of-fact replies in a level tone; no speeches.
abilities: Size: Shrinks or enlarges a nonliving object she touches; never a living thing.
Portable supplies: Carries shrunken rescue gear and restores it on the spot.
Obstacle setup: Enlarges an object into a barricade, clear of people.
Provisional license: May use her Quirk in an emergency; it does not make her a pro.
Fighting style: Shapes the scene with objects resized on cue and leaves the capture to teammates.
Yui Kodai (Provisional License).visualDescription: A young woman with a straight black shoulder-length bob and a side-swept fringe, narrow blue eyes, a calm, still face, fair skin and a medium build. She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Calm, unreadable expression with a hint of resolve.
